headline: Tesla launches Guaranteed Future Value program for Model Y and Model 3 — buyers can lock in a minimum trade-in value at purchase, eliminating out-of-pocket risk at next vehicle swap; program designed to remove the residual-value uncertainty that has deterred EV buyers in a volatile used-car market; available in select markets; reduces effective total cost of ownership and addresses a key objection from mainstream ICE defectors; demand catalyst heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (Ground News / The West Australian, Jul 14, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 first Teslascope-recorded drive completes 100% autonomously — Teslascope confirmed the very first logged drive on build 2026.20.6.6 was completed entirely on FSD with zero interventions; early user reports broadly positive on the new camera-preview-at-any-time feature; basenor confirmed rollout continuing; 100% completion rate on first logged drive is a notable early data point ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings where FSD reliability metrics will be a focus (basenor / Teslascope, Jul 14, 2026)

TSLA -3.48% on July 13 — broad tech selloff ahead of heavy economic data week; Jefferies lifts Tesla PT to $400 on Q2 delivery beat and raises Q2 EBIT estimate to $1.45B (5.1% margin), increasing outer-year EBIT by ~6%; 7 analysts now have revised Q2 earnings higher; market focus fully on Jul 22 Q2 print — key questions: automotive gross margin (consensus 18–20% ex-credits), Cybercab commercial launch timeline, and $25B capex FCF impact; TSLA trading ~$394 (trading range: $391–$407) as bears wait for margin confirmation before committing (tradingkey / Jefferies / Daily Political / invezz, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla FSD inches toward Italy approval — Tesla submitted FSD homologation paperwork to Italy's Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport; General Director Servedio Gaetano confirmed on LinkedIn the filing is in active analysis; Italy applying Netherlands fast-track recognition path; follows Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, and Lithuania approvals since May; Italy is the 6th EU country to formally engage with FSD post-Netherlands clearance and the bloc's 4th-largest market; as each EU approval uses the Netherlands as foundational clearance, incremental approvals are coming faster; EU TCMV vote window still open in July (notateslaapp / TeslaNewswire / MirkoMontagna0 on X, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla Robotaxi fleet near-flawless in new NHTSA safety report (Apr 15–Jun 16) — Tesla logged only 1 incident in 62 days of unsupervised Austin operation: a zero-fault event where a stationary Robotaxi obeying a red arrow signal was rear-ended by a human-driven pickup truck; Zoox logged +6 incidents, Waymo +191 in the same period; data not normalized by fleet miles, but confirms Tesla's Austin operational envelope is performing at extremely high reliability; directly challenges the '4x human crash rate' framing from earlier NHTSA filings; strongest safety data point yet heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (notateslaapp / NHTSA filings, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla tears down Model S/X production lines at Fremont for Optimus — official @gigafactories X account posts time-lapse: 'End of an era: Decommissioning the original Model S & X assembly line in just 46 days'; footage shows massive robotic arms removed, structural foundations cleared, concrete floor completely repoured; AI chief Ashok Elluswamy: 'Big shoes to fill, but I'm confident Optimus will not disappoint!!'; confirms Optimus production line installation is progressing on schedule toward late-July/August production start (notateslaapp / @gigafactories on X / Elluswamy on X, Jul 13, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 begins rolling out (build 2026.20.6.6) — camera preview now accessible at any time (not just during active FSD engagement); Tesla app now shows live FSD active status indicator while driving; concurrent v14.3.4 (2026.14.6.12) received mixed user reception per TeslaOracle; basenor confirmed rollout started July 13 morning; incremental UX improvements confirm Tesla maintaining aggressive FSD software cadence heading into the pivotal Jul 22 Q2 earnings report (basenor / TeslaOracle, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla Austin Robotaxi Hub confirmed with autonomous cleaning robot — Texas state building permit reveals first-ever automated cleaning robot deployed at Tesla's 5900 E Ben White Blvd Austin robotaxi hub alongside V4 Superchargers and an equipment inspection system; crews removed boundary fences and tarps, signaling hub entering active operations; fully autonomous cleaning infrastructure eliminates the human labor bottleneck for scaling a 24/7 Cybercab commercial fleet; no other robotaxi operator (Waymo, Zoox) has publicly disclosed autonomous vehicle cleaning at commercial hubs (notateslaapp / Teslarati, Jul 12, 2026)

Tesla confirms Cybercab employee rides 'starting soon' at Giga Texas — official Tesla Robotaxi account posted video of production Cybercab (no steering wheel, no pedals) autonomously picking up and dropping off employees in the Giga Texas outbound lot; basenor: 'Tesla has quietly crossed a line that no major automaker has crossed before'; Electrek notes ambiguity on whether operations are parking-lot-only or public roads; original post included Robotaxi app vent-control UI clip (later edited out — sparking speculation about app feature depth); first time purpose-built Level 4 hardware has transported employees at commercial-adjacent scale (notateslaapp / basenor / Electrek, Jul 11, 2026)

Musk mandates Grok 4.5 at Tesla; caps rival AI tools at $200/week per employee — Elon Musk directed all Tesla staff to adopt xAI's Grok 4.5 wherever possible and imposed a $200/week per-employee spending cap on third-party AI tools; Grok 4.5 costs ~$0.13/task vs ~$1.57 for alternatives — a 12x cost advantage; plans confirmed for Grok 4.5 integration into Tesla vehicles by fall 2026; deepens xAI-Tesla operational integration and channels compute spend to xAI, cutting AI opex significantly ahead of Q2 earnings Jul 22 (The Information / Electrek, Jul 11, 2026)
